tables.sql: SELECT id, seller_id, model_id, title, description, brand, model, year, displacement_cc, mileage, engine_type, country_code, city, verification_level, is_verified, has_circulacion, has_sticker, has_seguro, seller_type, status, color, created_at, updated_at FROM listings WHERE status != 'archived'
SELECT id AS listing_id, LN(price) AS log_price FROM listings WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 AND status != 'archived' AND MOD(ABS(HASHTEXT(id::text)), 3) IN (0, 1)
SELECT id AS listing_id, LN(price) AS log_price FROM listings WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 AND status != 'archived' AND MOD(ABS(HASHTEXT(id::text)), 3) = 2
SELECT id AS listing_id, LN(price) AS log_price FROM listings WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 AND status != 'archived' AND MOD(ABS(HASHTEXT(id::text)), 3) = 2
